question: Are the bundled compatibility and message-delivery changes sufficiently verified against provider-native clients and contracts to land together?
rationale: Focused emulator tests establish Crabline's internal behavior but cannot determine whether every stricter rejection, normalization rule, and backpressure transition faithfully matches the real providers.

options.title: Require provider-level evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open until each observable behavior has authoritative documentation, upstream source evidence, or a redacted compatible-client transcript.

options.title: Land verified subsets
options.body: Split independently verified fixes from changes whose exact provider semantics remain uncertain.

options.title: Accept the compatibility risk
options.body: Merge the bundle only after explicitly accepting possible differences for existing compatible clients and delivery behavior.

recommendation.title: Require provider-level evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until each observable behavior has authoritative documentation, upstream source evidence, or a redacted compatible-client transcript.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member currently carrying the cross-provider fidelity audit and can provide evidence or narrow the patch.
